days.name: Sun 02/15
days.dinner_description: Dining out at the Range Cafe in Albuquerque. New Mexican taco salad with all the fixings in a crispy tortilla bowl.
days.album_description: Houston trio's fourth album blends global psychedelia with soul, funk, and dub. The perfect soundtrack for a Southwest road trip day.
days.album_sonic_description: Surf guitar, deep bass, sparse drums, global influences spanning Thai funk to Jamaican dub
days.album_pairing_rationale: Khruangbin's desert-tinged global grooves are the ideal road trip companion for an Albuquerque Sunday. Their unhurried vibe matches the relaxed pace of dining out.
days.activity: Family trip in Albuquerque - Sandia Mountains
days.activity_notes: Last day in ABQ, enjoy the mountains and family time

days.name: Mon 02/16
days.dinner_description: Dining out at La Guelaguetza in Albuquerque. Birria-topped pizza with consommé for dipping — a stunning fusion of Oaxacan and Italian traditions.
days.album_description: Tuareg desert blues from Algeria. Hypnotic guitar patterns and Saharan rhythms that complement the bold Oaxacan flavors.
days.album_sonic_description: Tishoumaren guitar, pentatonic melodies, polyrhythmic percussion, call-and-response vocals
days.album_pairing_rationale: Desert blues from the Sahara meeting birria from Oaxaca — two ancient culinary and musical traditions from arid lands, connected by warmth and spice.
days.activity_notes: Presidents' Day - enjoy the last of the trip

days.name: Tue 02/17
days.calendar: Travel day - fly home to Dulles. On-call starts. Swim lessons.
days.dinner_description: Grab-and-go at the airport. Travel day means convenience over cuisine. Arrive Dulles at 11pm.
days.dinner_notes: Travel day - random airport food, arriving Dulles 11pm
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Airport meal - try to grab something with protein and vegetables
days.album_description: Trip-hop meets alternative R&B. Late-night, smoke-filled-room energy perfect for a red-eye arrival.
days.album_sonic_description: Trip-hop beats, jazz guitar, baritone vocals, ambient textures
days.album_pairing_rationale: The perfect album for a foggy travel night — Puma Blue's nocturnal atmosphere mirrors the haze of airports and late arrivals.
days.activity_notes: Long travel day, arrive late. First day of on-call rotation.
prep_notes: Unpack and settle in after late arrival

days.name: Wed 02/18
days.calendar: First full day back. On-call. Talks & Taps 3-5pm. Happy Hour 4:30-6pm.
time_constraints: Late dinner after happy hour events (after 6pm)
days.dinner: Winter Kale Caesar with Roasted Chickpeas & Shaved Parmesan
days.dinner_description: A hearty dinner-sized salad of massaged lacinato kale, crispy roasted chickpeas, toasted sourdough breadcrumbs, shaved Parmesan, soft-boiled egg, and creamy homemade Caesar dressing. Finished with pickled red onion and roasted cherry tomatoes for extra interest.
days.dinner_notes: Easy to assemble after the happy hour. Chickpeas can be roasted earlier in the day. Added soft-boiled eggs, pickled onion, and roasted tomatoes for substance.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Excellent iron from kale, protein from chickpeas and egg, vitamin C from lemon
days.album_description: Welsh art-pop shapeshifter's latest. Dream pop meets angular post-punk. Perfect for a contemplative salad night.
days.album_sonic_description: Angular guitars, warm synths, art-pop arrangements, ethereal vocals
days.album_pairing_rationale: A cerebral, dreamy album for a contemplative evening — you're back from travel, settling in, eating clean. Le Bon's art-pop matches the salad's composed elegance.
days.activity_notes: First full day home. Unpack remaining bags, grocery run for the week.
prep_notes: Roast chickpeas in the morning or afternoon

days.name: Thu 02/19
days.weather_detail: Mostly Sunny (60%), wind 10 mph, 63% precip, 0.50in rain
time_constraints: Meetings end by 3:30pm - good cooking window
days.dinner: Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Mushroom Cream Sauce
days.dinner_description: Thick bone-in pork chops seared to a golden crust, finished in a velvety sauce of sautéed cremini and shiitake mushrooms, white wine, garlic, thyme, and cream. Served with mashed potatoes.
days.dinner_notes: Take pork chops out of freezer Wednesday night to thaw. Rich, comforting meal for a rainy on-call Thursday.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Good protein from pork, B vitamins from mushrooms. Add a green side for balance.
days.album_description: Family favorite's newest album! London duo's signature bass-driven funk-disco. They're playing 9:30 Club on Feb 19!
days.album_sonic_description: Thick bass, disco beats, falsetto vocals, funky guitar, synth flourishes
days.album_pairing_rationale: It's Franc Moody day! They're literally playing 9:30 Club tonight. Their peppy energy will power you through cooking pork chops on a rainy Thursday. Family favorite meets comfort food.
days.activity_notes: Consider catching the show if on-call allows!
prep_notes: Thaw pork chops overnight (move from freezer Wed night)

days.name: Fri 02/20
days.weather_detail: Mostly Cloudy (53%), wind 16 mph gusts 35, 70% precip, 0.20in rain
days.weather_oneliner: 64°/44° · warmest of the week, breezy & wet
days.dinner: Roasted Branzino with Cherry Tomatoes, Lemon & Capers
days.dinner_description: Whole branzino scored and stuffed with lemon slices, garlic, and fresh herbs, roasted on a bed of burst cherry tomatoes and briny capers. Crispy skin, flaky flesh.
days.dinner_notes: Prep the fish before Elsie's YAT pickup. Pop in oven when you get home — only 20 min to cook. Fast, elegant, impressive.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Excellent omega-3s from branzino, vitamin C from tomatoes and lemon, healthy fats from olive oil
days.album_description: Ethereal Japanese folk-ambient album evoking oceanic landscapes. Aoba's crystalline voice creates an atmosphere as delicate as the branzino itself.
days.album_sonic_description: Fingerpicked classical guitar, layered vocals, ambient orchestration, field recordings
days.album_pairing_rationale: Ichiko Aoba's oceanic folk is the perfect sonic companion for whole roasted fish — both are delicate, beautiful, and reward attention. The album's Japanese sensibility bridges the Mediterranean dish with Eastern aesthetics.
days.activity_notes: Kim Waters at Blues Alley this weekend if you want live jazz
prep_notes: Buy fresh branzino (or order from fish counter)
Score, stuff, and have pan ready — 20 min roast when home

days.name: Sat 02/21
days.dinner: Braised White Beans with Winter Greens & Sourdough Toast
days.dinner_description: Cannellini beans braised with garlic, rosemary, and chili flakes until creamy, topped with wilted lacinato kale and served over thick sourdough toast rubbed with raw garlic. Finished with a generous drizzle of good olive oil and flaky salt.
days.dinner_notes: The star is the fresh sourdough. Thick slices, rubbed with garlic, toasted until golden. Simple Tuscan rusticity.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: High fiber from beans and kale, plant protein, iron, vitamin K
days.album_description: Irish folk brothers with inviting harmonies. Like sitting by the fire in a stone cottage with fresh bread on the table.
days.album_sonic_description: Close harmonies, acoustic guitar, fiddle, bodhrán, stripped-back arrangements
days.album_pairing_rationale: Rustic Irish folk for a rustic Tuscan dinner — both traditions celebrate simplicity, community, and the warmth of a shared table. The close harmonies are as nourishing as the sourdough.
days.activity: Bake and enjoy fresh sourdough bread
days.activity_notes: Relaxed Saturday. Good day to bake, read, and rest.
prep_notes: Sourdough should be ready for baking
Soak beans overnight Friday if using dried

appetizers.name: Whipped Ricotta Crostini with Honey & Walnuts
appetizers.description: Creamy whipped ricotta on toasted sourdough crostini, drizzled with honey, scattered with toasted walnuts and cracked black pepper.

appetizers.name: Roasted Sweet Potato Rounds with Goat Cheese & Pecans
appetizers.description: Roasted sweet potato coins topped with tangy goat cheese, toasted pecans, dried cranberries, and honey.

salads.name: Winter Citrus & Radicchio Salad
salads.description: Blood orange and cara cara segments with shaved radicchio, burrata, pistachios, and Castelvetrano olives. Blood orange vinaigrette.
salads.dressing: Blood orange vinaigrette: fresh blood orange juice, champagne vinegar, Dijon mustard, EVOO, minced shallot, flaky salt
salads.flavor_rationale: Bitter radicchio tamed by sweet citrus and creamy burrata. Italian amaro-dolce-grasso balance.

salads.name: Warm Farro & Roasted Root Vegetable Salad
salads.description: Chewy farro with roasted beets, carrots, parsnips, goat cheese, and hazelnuts in warm sherry vinaigrette.
salads.dressing: Warm sherry vinaigrette: sherry vinegar, Dijon, minced shallot, EVOO, honey, fresh thyme
salads.flavor_rationale: Earthy roots, nutty farro, tangy goat cheese, and bright vinaigrette. Hearty winter sustenance.

salads.name: Shaved Brussels Sprout Slaw with Apple & Pecorino
salads.description: Paper-thin Brussels sprouts with Honeycrisp apple matchsticks, Pecorino, and toasted pecans.
salads.dressing: Lemon-Dijon: fresh lemon juice, Dijon mustard, honey, EVOO, apple cider vinegar
salads.flavor_rationale: Brussels bitterness balanced by sweet apple and honey. Pecorino adds umami, pecans add crunch.

salads.name: Roasted Beet & Pomegranate Salad with Labneh
salads.description: Golden and red beets with pomegranate seeds, labneh, walnuts, and mint.
salads.dressing: Pomegranate-za'atar vinaigrette: pomegranate molasses, red wine vinegar, za'atar, EVOO, Aleppo pepper
salads.flavor_rationale: Sweet beets + tart pomegranate + tangy labneh. Middle Eastern sweet-tart-creamy-aromatic balance.

beverages.name: Malbec (Mendoza, Argentina)
beverages.description: Full-bodied red with dark fruit, plum, and chocolate. Perfect for pork chops and rich dishes.
beverages.why: Complements the mushroom cream sauce on Thursday and pairs with the week's heartier meals.

beverages.name: Sancerre (Loire Valley, France)
beverages.description: Crisp, mineral-driven Sauvignon Blanc with citrus and white peach. The ideal white for branzino.
beverages.why: Classic pairing with whole roasted fish. The acidity mirrors the lemon and capers.

beverages.name: Yuzu Ginger Sparkling Mocktail
beverages.description: Sparkling water with fresh yuzu juice, grated ginger, honey, and mint. Refreshing and alcohol-free.
beverages.why: Non-alcoholic option for on-call nights and kid-friendly. Pairs with the kale Caesar.

Pantry: cannellini beans (2 cans or 1 lb dried)

prep_ahead: Tuesday night: Move pork chops from freezer to fridge to thaw
Wednesday morning: Roast chickpeas for the kale Caesar, make Caesar dressing
Wednesday evening: Massage kale, pickle red onions
Thursday afternoon: Prep mashed potatoes, slice mushrooms
Friday before YAT pickup: Score and stuff branzino, prep cherry tomato pan
Friday night: Soak cannellini beans for Saturday (if using dried)
notes: Dan is on-call as Incident Manager Tuesday through Tuesday — keep weeknight dinners manageable
Swim lessons Tuesday evening, Elsie YAT 4:30-6:00 Friday
Franc Moody playing 9:30 Club Thursday Feb 19 — consider going!
Kim Waters at Blues Alley Feb 20-22 for live jazz
Fresh sourdough bread on Saturday is the culinary anchor of the week's end
